usedFor: SurveyMethods collects survey answers, and Microsoft Excel stores them when “Add Row To Table” follows “New Response Completed”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Response Completed” in SurveyMethods, then “Add Row To Table” in Microsoft Excel
bestTemplate.why: Each finished response becomes a row, so results sit in a table you can sort and chart.

watchOut: “Add Row To Table” writes into an existing Excel table, so create the table and its columns first.
